correctness.rationale: Averaging over vertex automorphisms preserves both means and yields three orbit distances satisfying a≤2c and b≤a+c≤3c. The intrinsic graph metric attains equality. For real L1, Tonelli reduces to indicator cuts whose exact boundary is (n−1)s−2kℓ+2t. Maximizing by kℓ≤floor(s²/4), t≥0 and using the increasing rational envelope gives the even endpoint. The floor term proves the odd endpoint and equality rigidity. Complete finite checks provide corroboration, not an infinite proof.

These are meaningful all-size quantitative and equality structures, not one arbitrary finite computation.
